search.query: | mstats avg("kernel.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("kernel.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*kexec_crash_loaded*","*kdump_active*","*tainted*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

panel.title: New oops / panic / BUG since last cycle

search.query: | mstats avg("kernel.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*oops_new*","*panic_new*","*bug_new*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
